# 7404 - Hex inverter

Package DIP-14 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/7404.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/7404.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 5 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![7404 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/7404.png) | ![7404 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/not1.png) | ![7404 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/not1.png) |

A small rectangle with a triangle drawn inside it pointing right: two lines from the left corners meet at the middle of the right side.

How to tell it on a drawing: Box with an inner right-pointing triangle = inverter.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | 1Y = NOT 1A | 1Y is the inverse of 1A. |
| 4 | 2Y = NOT 2A | 2Y is the inverse of 2A. |
| 6 | 3Y = NOT 3A | 3Y is the inverse of 3A. |
| 8 | 4Y = NOT 4A | 4Y is the inverse of 4A. |
| 10 | 5Y = NOT 5A | 5Y is the inverse of 5A. |
| 12 | 6Y = NOT 6A | 6Y is the inverse of 6A. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 16 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -0.4 |
| inputSchmitt | no |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 400 ohm, CL 15 pF.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| any | Y | PLH | 12 | 22 |
| any | Y | PHL | 8 | 15 |

## Notes

The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delay; minNs is null (the path-delay function uses 0 ns). No setup/hold/pulse-width limits apply to a gate, so timingLimits is empty.
